|game_text=Deploy on a Dagobah site. Target a mentor on Dagobah and an apprentice who has completed Jedi Test #4. Attempt when apprentice is present at the beginning of your control phase. Reveal the top two cards of your Reserve Deck and place one upside down on apprentice. Whenever you are about to draw a card for destiny, you may instead use the upside-down card (which remains on apprentice for re-use).
